content.goal: Create a responsive web app that lets a user observe and control a realistic three-light traffic signal simulation.
content.summary: A single-page traffic-light simulator presents one vertical red-yellow-green signal, a live phase countdown, automatic and manual controls, editable phase durations, and redundant text cues for accessibility. The default automatic cycle is Red for 5 seconds, Green for 5 seconds, Yellow for 2 seconds, then back to Red.

outcomes.description: The user can clearly see the active red, yellow, or green phase and its remaining time as the simulator follows Red -> Green -> Yellow -> Red.
The user can start or pause automatic playback, advance one phase manually, reset to red, and change playback speed.
The user can set positive whole-second durations for red, yellow, and green; accepted values apply to subsequent phases without corrupting the active countdown.
Active state is communicated by lamp position, visible phase text, and live countdown rather than color alone; controls have keyboard focus and meaningful labels.

artifacts.title: Traffic light simulator
artifacts.description: Responsive single-page interface. On narrow screens, place the control panel below the signal panel while retaining the same content order. Start begins or resumes the automatic cycle. Pause freezes the current countdown. Next advances immediately to the next phase and restarts that phase's configured countdown. Reset pauses playback and restores the red phase at its full configured duration. Speed choices are 0.5x, 1x, and 2x. Duration inputs accept whole seconds from 1 through 60; invalid values show an inline error and are not applied. When a duration changes during its own active phase, the current countdown continues unchanged and the new value takes effect the next time that phase begins.

boxes.label: Traffic Light Lab
boxes.caption: Explore signal timing at your own pace

boxes.label: Red
boxes.caption: Stop
boxes.details: The active red lamp is brightly filled; inactive lamps are dimmed while retaining their visible labels.

boxes.label: Yellow
boxes.caption: Prepare
boxes.details: The active yellow lamp is brightly filled; inactive lamps are dimmed while retaining their visible labels.

boxes.label: Green
boxes.caption: Go
boxes.details: The active green lamp is brightly filled; inactive lamps are dimmed while retaining their visible labels.

boxes.label: RED - 5 seconds remaining
boxes.caption: Paused
boxes.details: An aria-live polite status announces phase changes and playback changes, but not every countdown tick. The visible text updates every second.

boxes.label: Controls
boxes.caption: Run, step, and tune the cycle

boxes.label: Playback
boxes.caption: Start / Pause   Next   Reset
boxes.details: Start changes to Pause while running. Next performs one immediate phase transition. Reset pauses and restores a full red phase. The selected speed multiplies countdown progression without changing configured duration values.

boxes.label: Phase durations
boxes.caption: Whole seconds, 1 to 60
boxes.details: Each phase has a labeled numeric input. Save timings validates all fields together. Invalid fields receive a specific inline message and focus moves to the first error. Successful values become the next-cycle configuration.

boxes.label: State is never shown by color alone
boxes.caption: Labels, position, and status text remain visible
boxes.details: Use semantic buttons and labeled numeric inputs, visible keyboard focus, sufficient contrast in active and inactive states, reduced-motion-safe transitions, and an aria-live region for meaningful state changes.
